children: Regional Management presented strategic and financial updates highlighting $2.1 billion in receivables and expansion to 20 states with digital and AI-enabled growth initiatives.
$2.1B total receivables and 357 branches across 20 states, signaling continued geographic expansion.
Originations exceeded $1.9B via branches, direct mail, and digital channels; end-to-end digital lending launched July 2026.
Portfolio grew 9.6% YoY in large loans; auto-secured loans rose to 15.1% of portfolio, improving risk-adjusted mix.
Operating expense ratio improved to 12.4% (80 bps YoY) as revenue growth outpaced G&A by 4.2x.
Strong liquidity and funding: $442M unused capacity (subject to borrowing base), $128M available liquidity, 80% fixed-rate debt.
